## 2026-08-28 — Kept fresh, still undecided

A short entry for a thin day. The only two signals were the same two Dependabot pull requests on `literature-example-hcllms` — [#19](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms/pull/19) (32-package production group) and [#1](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms/pull/1) (5 CI actions) — already covered in full on the 21st, resurfaced only by another automated rebase. Instead of re-listing packages, the entry turns on the rebase itself: Dependabot keeps the branches mergeable and green so the PRs look maintained while remaining undecided since June/July, an inversion of the 26th's note that a clock eventually disposes of these.

### Signals
- 2 source PRs (both `literature-example-hcllms`, rebase-nudged, unchanged in substance)
- 0 source issues, 0 releases, 0 discussions, 0 diary issues

### Changes
- Added `content/diary/2026-08-28.md`
- Updated `content/diary/_meta.json` (newest first)

No idea note planted — the substance lives in the existing `shared-ancestry-shared-exposure` note. JSON validated; `npm run check` surfaces only pre-existing environmental type errors (dependencies not installed), unrelated to the content changes.

## Summary of PR/Issue

This PR adds the auto-diary entry `content/diary/2026-08-28.md` (+35) and prepends `2026-08-28` to `content/diary/_meta.json` (newest-first). The day had only two signals — the same two Dependabot PRs on `literature-example-hcllms` ([#19](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms/pull/19), 32-package prod group; [#1](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms/pull/1), 5 CI actions) already dissected on the 21st and resurfaced only by another automated rebase. Rather than re-list packages, the entry turns on a genuine observation: a rebase-only resurfacing keeps a branch *looking* tended while it stays undecided — an inversion of the 26th's "a clock eventually disposes of these." Scope is correct (content-only) and the change fits the diary workflow.

## Review

One reviewer; verdict SHIP. The entry is factually accurate, mechanically clean, and makes the right editorial call for a thin day; the only finding is an optional garden-connectivity nit.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Entry has no outbound garden wikilinks | INFO | The entry references the idea note by concept ("all of it is already written down") but, unlike the 21st and 26th entries, includes no inline wikilink to `shared-ancestry-shared-exposure`. Optional; not a correctness issue. |

## Progress

- **Factual accuracy verified** — PR #19 (created 2026-07-31, OPEN) and PR #1 (created 2026-06-05, OPEN) dates/state match; the 26th quote is verbatim; the "second rebase-only resurfacing" continuity (14th arrival → 21st → 28th) is internally consistent.
- **Mechanical checks clean** — `_meta.json` is valid JSON, 32 entries, no duplicates, strictly newest-first, with exact file/manifest correspondence and no orphans.
- **Scope correct** — both files live under `content/diary/`, honoring the "diary automation writes only under `content/`" rule; frontmatter and H2 conventions match prior entries.
- **No idea note planted** — intentional and consistent with the 26th precedent; substance stays in the existing `shared-ancestry-shared-exposure` note (out of scope by design).
- **`npm run check`** surfaces only pre-existing environmental type errors (deps not installed), consistent with a content-only change.
- **Inline comment posted** — one INFO comment at `content/diary/2026-08-28.md:21` flagging the missing wikilink. No prior inline comments or review threads existed.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Entry has no outbound garden wikilinks (INFO)</summary>

**Cause:** The entry names "the 21st" and "the 26th" and alludes to the idea note ("the down-the-tree leaf, the born-owing #1 — all of it is already written down") but contains no wikilinks. The 21st (`2026-08-21.md:30`) and 26th (`2026-08-26.md:20`) both linked `../ideas/shared-ancestry-shared-exposure` inline, so a reader following the 28th's "already written down" thread has nothing to click.

**Candidate solutions:** Add an inline wikilink to `../ideas/shared-ancestry-shared-exposure` at the "already written down" clause (line 21), matching the prior entries' pattern.

**Comments:** Non-blocking. The entry is not an orphan (it is listed in `_meta.json`) and the idea note remains well-linked from prior entries, so this is a mild connectivity nicety rather than a defect — a style/maintainer call.
</details>

## Recommended Next Step

`HUMAN_DECISION` — the only open item is an optional garden-connectivity/style choice (add a wikilink); the PR is shippable as-is, so whether to apply it is a maintainer/agent judgment rather than a required automated fix.

## Final Verdict

`SHIP`
